# v1.12.6 — My Team launcher icon

## Changes

- Replaced the Android launcher icon with the supplied **My Team** artwork (three people and a checkmark).
- Prepared the artwork for Android adaptive icons: removed only the outer white background while preserving the white checkmark, produced a 1024×1024 transparent-corner icon, scaled the foreground to stay within the launcher mask safe area, and sampled the matching `#070C20` adaptive background from the artwork.
- Added the source and generated artwork under `mobile/assets/icon/`; CI regenerates launcher icons with `flutter_launcher_icons` on APK builds when the source icon is present.
- Fixed the repository PNG ignore exception so the committed launcher artwork is not silently omitted from Git.
- Mobile package version: **1.12.6+19**. No backend or frontend behavior changed in this release.

## Verification

- Regenerated icons locally with Flutter 3.24.3 and spot-checked the transparent corners and artwork placement.
- Docker Compose configuration passed validation. Dart application code was unchanged.
